Name: PCI-DSS v4.0 (Payment Card Industry) for OCI
Description: Security standards for organizations handling branded credit cards across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure workloads.

Requirements.Name: Network Security Controls & Boundary Protection
Requirements.Description: Network security controls are configured and maintained to restrict connections to and from the cardholder data environment (CDE).

Attributes.Section: Build and Maintain a Secure Network

Requirements.Name: Protect Cardholder Data at Rest with Strong Cryptography
Requirements.Description: Render primary account numbers (PAN) unreadable anywhere it is stored with customer-managed encryption keys and automated rotation.

Requirements.Name: Identification and Authentication Management (MFA & Passwords)
Requirements.Description: Enforce MFA for all administrative access and configure strict password complexity, history, and expiration policies.

Requirements.Name: Log and Monitor All Access to System Components
Requirements.Description: Audit logging is enabled for all system components, retained for 1 year, and alerted on critical security events.
